name: File Transformation
overview: Jellyfin 12.4 adaptation build of File Transformation 3.0.0 (upstream: IAmParadox27/jellyfin-plugin-file-transformation).
description: Allows other plugins to intercept and change the delivered web content of jellyfin-web. This build targets Jellyfin 12.4 (net10.0); source changes are limited to the JellyfinVersion bump (csproj property + assembly attribute).

versions.changelog: Rebuilt against Jellyfin 12.4.0 packages (net10.0). No functional changes vs upstream 3.0.0.

name: Jellyframe
overview: Jellyfin 12.4 adaptation build of JellyFrame 1.5.3 (upstream: Jellyfin-PG/JellyFrame).
description: A complete customization and extension framework for Jellyfin: community mods and themes from the dashboard, plus a server-side JavaScript API. Requires the File Transformation plugin. This build targets Jellyfin 12.4 (net10.0, Jellyfin.Controller/Model 12.4.0) and fixes the three 12.4 API breaks (IPlaylistManager.AddItemToPlaylistAsync signature, IUserManager.ResetPassword(Guid), IUserManager.Users removed).

versions.changelog: Jellyfin 12.4 adaptation: net10.0 + Jellyfin.Controller/Model 12.4.0 + Microsoft.Data.Sqlite 10.0.12; fixed AddItemToPlaylistAsync/ResetPassword/GetUsers API breaks in JellyfinSurface.
